```{r}
#loading Libraries
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
movie_data_raw <- read.csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
target_cols <- c("budget", "roi", "franchise_status")

movie_data <- movie_data_raw |>
  select(all_of(target_cols)) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) na_if(x, 0))) |> 
  mutate(
    franchise_status = factor(franchise_status)
  )
```
